quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer findings or runtime draws. Inspect direct symmetric/nontransitive pairs against actual full titles and ordinary senses, including excesses. Shared topics, homophony and an indirect guard alone do not establish a pair.

体操 assesses exercise, PE/gymnastics and sporting-discipline labels without teaching obsolete school-subject sense 3 as modern. 題名 assesses title/heading and broad name labels. 代名詞 assesses figurative representative/example/pattern labels, not physical molds by shape alone.

ダイヤグラム assesses diagram/chart and public-backed transport scheduling labels. 表 is primary おもて but its old body explicitly teaches separate ひょう/chart; do not pretend that is its primary reading. This broad written-form guard is reviewable, not a silent entry merger.

ダイヤモンド assesses abbreviation/gem labels; ダイヤル assesses 回す's exact telephone-dialing secondary use. Opposing-side words require individual confrontation/opposition evidence; 対照 and mere fighting topics are not automatic pairs.

田植え assesses broad plant-action label, not every stage of cultivation. 絶えず assesses continuous/all-times uses, including いつでも and どんどん's actual secondary senses, without copying all general-frequency guards.

高める assesses level/degree enhancement, development and increase labels; 蓄える also assesses knowledge/skill development and beard growth, including direct new-new 高める and old 伸ばす, ordinary こしらえる money accumulation, and storage labels. Different Japanese argument structures do not by themselves disambiguate an English increase/grow answer.
炊く assesses broad food-preparation labels, retaining the regional qualification of broader boiling. 焚く assesses burn/scorch and additional bath-heating labels; homophony alone does not guard 炊く/焚く.
タイヤ, 楕円 and 滝 have no new declarations. Already complete reused safeguards are preserved; exact English title equality needs no added guard. No exhaustive semantic uniqueness is claimed.
sourceAccessLimits: Only 226 selected original complete families plus the explicitly read supplemental union are asserted read; not all 302 original captures. The union already includes twenty principal identities.
115 original complete bodies plus seven supplemental captures are deduplicated; all original 169 labels were read, but not all corresponding original captured bodies are asserted read.

Twenty-two Weblio endpoint captures are not twenty-two independent dictionaries; mixed unrelated headings are separated from exact claims. Reviewer access to author captures is not fresh independent retrieval.
Completion receipts and structural checks do not certify exhaustive linguistic correctness, corpus frequency, historical origin, native-speaker judgment or actual runtime quiz uniqueness.
Four reuses: だいぶ unchanged at N4; 大木/耕す/竹 only sourced absent-level to N2 plus appended citations. Inherited prose is preserved; new independent verification of every baseline claim is not asserted.
Two newly added primary reciprocal pairs are 詞/代名詞 and 植/田植え. Existing 耕/耕す and 竹/竹 links are checked/preserved, not counted as newly authored pairs.
File-only reviewers cannot independently execute Git/hash/equivalence checks. No independent reviews, native-speaker certification or runtime quiz draws are claimed by author inspection.
